title: Cloudflare Status - Network issues in Incheon (ICN)
text:
Service: Cloudflare Status
Incident: Network issues in Incheon (ICN)
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2026-10-16T01:13:00.000Z
Resolved: 2026-10-16T02:11:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-16T02:28:46.992Z: resolved - Between 01:13 AM and 02:11 AM UTC, network performance at our ICN-A colo in Seoul was impacted. Users downstream of KINX may have experienced increased latency (TTFB) and elevated Network Error Logging (NEL) metrics due to network path congestion. Performance metrics have since returned to normal baselines, and the issue is now fully resolved.
